summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, furnishing a Regulatory News Service announcement dated 11 September 2026. The disclosure covers routine monthly acquisitions of Partnership Shares and awards of Matching Shares under the Group's Share Incentive Plan on 9 September 2026 for several PDMRs, including Chirantan Barua, Kate Cheetham, Sharon Doherty and Amanda Murphy, at GBP1.121 per Partnership Share and nil-cost Matching Shares, transacted outside a trading venue. No merger, tender, buyback, strategic review or board change is implicated; the filing is an ordinary insider shareholding notification with no deal terms or risk-arb angle.
